title: Code Detectors Have a Half-Life: Obsolescence and Metric Illusions in LLM-Generated Code Detection
title_zh: 代码检测器有半衰期：LLM生成代码检测中的过时与指标幻象

paragraphs.en: Code detectors can become obsolete as code-generating models evolve: a detector validated on one generation of models may not transfer to the next. We call this limited useful life a detector half- life. We evaluate eight general-purpose LLM judges and three dedicated detectors on human-written code and code produced by seven generators across C++, Java, and Python. Our results reveal two problems. First, performance varies considerably across generators and prompting strategies, suggesting that some detectors rely on generator-specific patterns rather than general evidence of code provenance. Second, accuracy can conceal severe prediction bias. DetectCodeGPT and GPT-Sniffer achieved an accuracy of 0.50 but an F 1 F_{1} score of 0.00 across all generators because they classified almost every sample as AI-generated. However, general-purpose LLM judges achieved stronger accuracy and F 1 F_{1} scores. Our results show that general-purpose LLMs are promising training-free judges of code provenance and can outperform dedicated detectors. However, their reliability depends on the judge model, the code generator, and the prompting strategy. We therefore recommend evaluating LLM judges across multiple generators and reporting macro- F 1 F_{1} alongside class-specific precision and recall.
paragraphs.zh: 随着代码生成模型的发展，代码检测器可能会变得过时：在一个模型代际上验证过的检测器可能无法有效应用于下一代模型。 我们将这种有限的实用寿命称为检测器的半衰期。 我们在人类编写的代码以及由七种代码生成器生成的 C++、Java 和 Python 代码上，评估了八种通用 LLM 判判和三种专用检测器。 我们的研究结果揭示了两个问题。 首先，不同生成器和提示策略之间的性能存在显著差异，这表明某些检测器依赖特定于生成器的模式，而非证明代码来源的一般性证据。 其次，准确率可能掩盖严重的预测偏差。 DetectCodeGPT 和 GPT-Sniffer 的准确率为 0.50，但在所有生成器上的 F 1 F_{1} 分数为 0.00，因为它们几乎将所有样本都分类为人工智能生成的代码。 然而，通用 LLM 判判在准确率和 F 1 F_{1} 分数上表现更优。 我们的结果表明，通用 LLM 是有望实现无需训练即可判断代码来源的工具，并且能够超越专用检测器。 然而，其可靠性取决于判判模型、代码生成器和提示策略。 因此，我们建议在不同生成器上对 LLM 判判进行多场景评估，并在报告类别特异性精确率和召回率的同时，提供宏观 F 1 F_{1} 分数。

paragraphs.en: LLMs now generate, complete, and refactor source code ( Zan et al., 2023 ; Hou et al., 2024 ) . Undisclosed use can undermine educational assessment, complicate license and intellectual-property review, and make security-sensitive code harder to vet, as LLMs can reproduce insecure patterns from their training data. Reliable code-provenance detection is therefore increasingly important. However, code is harder to classify than natural language because syntactic constraints compress the token-distribution differences used by text detectors ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ) . Existing detectors commonly require white-box access, labeled data, or dedicated infrastructure ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Nguyen et al., 2024 ; JianWang et al., 2024 ) . More fundamentally, they are validated against a bounded set of generators. As generator families and output styles evolve, reported performance may expire a limitation we call detector half-life . Furthermore, the common reliance of detectors on accuracy creates a second risk: on a balanced dataset, a detector that predicts only one class still scores 0.50.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）如今能够生成、补全和重构源代码（Zan 等，2023；Hou 等，2024）。 未经披露的使用可能会破坏教育评估的可靠性，使许可和知识产权审查变得复杂，并让安全敏感代码更难通过审核，因为 LLM 可能从其训练数据中复现不安全模式。 因此，可靠的代码来源检测变得越来越重要。 然而，与自然语言相比，代码更难分类，因为句法约束会压缩文本检测器所依赖的标记分布差异（Shi 等，2024；Ye 等，2024）。 现有的检测器通常需要白盒访问权限、带标签的数据或专用基础设施（Yang 等，2023；Nguyen 等，2024；JianWang 等，2024）。 更根本的是，这些检测器是在有限数量的生成器集合上得到验证的。 随着生成器家族和输出风格的演变，已报告的性能可能会失效，这一限制我们称之为“检测器半衰期”。 此外，检测器普遍依赖准确率的做法带来了第二个风险：在平衡的数据集上，一个仅预测单一类别的检测器仍然能获得 0.50 的得分。

sents.en: LLMs now generate, complete, and refactor source code ( Zan et al., 2023 ; Hou et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）如今能够生成、补全和重构源代码（Zan 等，2023；Hou 等，2024）。

sents.en: Undisclosed use can undermine educational assessment, complicate license and intellectual-property review, and make security-sensitive code harder to vet, as LLMs can reproduce insecure patterns from their training data.

sents.zh: 现有的检测器通常需要白盒访问权限、带标签的数据或专用基础设施（Yang 等，2023；Nguyen 等，2024；JianWang 等，2024）。

sents.zh: 更根本的是，这些检测器是在有限数量的生成器集合上得到验证的。

sents.en: Furthermore, the common reliance of detectors on accuracy creates a second risk: on a balanced dataset, a detector that predicts only one class still scores 0.50.
sents.zh: 此外，检测器普遍依赖准确率的做法带来了第二个风险：在平衡的数据集上，一个仅预测单一类别的检测器仍然能获得 0.50 的得分。

paragraphs.en: General-purpose LLMs offer a simple alternative. Instead of training a separate classifier, an LLM can be asked whether a program was written by a human or generated by another model. This makes LLM judges attractive as training-free detectors. However, LLM judgments can be affected by model preferences, prompting choices, and superficial code features ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Moon et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 通用型大型语言模型提供了一种简单的替代方案。 与其训练一个独立的分类器，不如让大型语言模型判断某个程序是由人类编写还是由其他模型生成的。 这使得大型语言模型裁判成为无需训练的检测工具，因而颇具吸引力。 然而，大型语言模型的判断可能受到模型偏好、提示选择以及代码表面特征的影响（Pan 等人，2024；Moon 等人，2026）。

sents.en: General-purpose LLMs offer a simple alternative.
sents.zh: 通用型大型语言模型提供了一种简单的替代方案。

sents.en: Instead of training a separate classifier, an LLM can be asked whether a program was written by a human or generated by another model.
sents.zh: 与其训练一个独立的分类器，不如让大型语言模型判断某个程序是由人类编写还是由其他模型生成的。

sents.en: This makes LLM judges attractive as training-free detectors.
sents.zh: 这使得大型语言模型裁判成为无需训练的检测工具，因而颇具吸引力。

sents.en: However, LLM judgments can be affected by model preferences, prompting choices, and superficial code features ( Pan et al., 2024 ; Moon et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 然而，大型语言模型的判断可能受到模型偏好、提示选择以及代码表面特征的影响（Pan 等人，2024；Moon 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: This paper studies both the promise and the limits of LLM judges. We compare eight general-purpose LLMs with three dedicated detectors across seven code generators and three programming languages. Specifically, we ask how accurately general-purpose LLMs distinguish AI-generated from human-written code without task-specific training ( RQ1 ), and how lexical, structural, and lexico-semantic guidance affect their accuracy and decision biases ( RQ2 ). We make the following contribution. ❶ evidence that current code detectors have a half-life; ❷ an empirical demonstration that accuracy can mask detector collapse; and ❸ a cross-generator evaluation of LLM judges as a more adaptable, though still imperfect, alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）判定的潜力与局限性。 我们在七种代码生成器和三种编程语言上，将八种通用型 LLM 与三种专用检测器进行了比较。 具体而言，我们探讨了通用型 LLM 在没有任务特定训练的情况下，能多准确地区分人工智能生成的代码与人类编写的代码（研究问题 1），以及词汇、结构和词汇-语义层面的引导如何影响其准确率和决策偏差（研究问题 2）。 我们的贡献如下：❶ 证明当前的代码检测器存在“半衰期”；❷ 通过实证展示，准确率可能掩盖检测器的失效；以及 ❸ 对 LLM 判定进行跨生成器评估，表明其是一种更具适应性但仍有缺陷的替代方案。

sents.en: This paper studies both the promise and the limits of LLM judges.
sents.zh: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）判定的潜力与局限性。

sents.en: We compare eight general-purpose LLMs with three dedicated detectors across seven code generators and three programming languages.
sents.zh: 我们在七种代码生成器和三种编程语言上，将八种通用型 LLM 与三种专用检测器进行了比较。

sents.en: Specifically, we ask how accurately general-purpose LLMs distinguish AI-generated from human-written code without task-specific training ( RQ1 ), and how lexical, structural, and lexico-semantic guidance affect their accuracy and decision biases ( RQ2 ).
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们探讨了通用型 LLM 在没有任务特定训练的情况下，能多准确地区分人工智能生成的代码与人类编写的代码（研究问题 1），以及词汇、结构和词汇-语义层面的引导如何影响其准确率和决策偏差（研究问题 2）。

sents.en: We make the following contribution. ❶ evidence that current code detectors have a half-life; ❷ an empirical demonstration that accuracy can mask detector collapse; and ❸ a cross-generator evaluation of LLM judges as a more adaptable, though still imperfect, alternative.
sents.zh: 我们的贡献如下：❶ 证明当前的代码检测器存在“半衰期”；❷ 通过实证展示，准确率可能掩盖检测器的失效；以及 ❸ 对 LLM 判定进行跨生成器评估，表明其是一种更具适应性但仍有缺陷的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: LLM-output detection uses trained classifiers, zero-shot statistics, or watermarking ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Mitchell et al., 2023 ) . Code-specific variants add stylistic, task-conditioned, finetuned, or signal-based features ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Skurla et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . These methods are typically tested on a fixed set of existing generators and reported mainly using accuracy, leaving their robustness to newer generators and susceptibility to class collapse unclear.
paragraphs.zh: LLM输出检测使用训练好的分类器、零样本统计或水印技术（Nguyen 等，2024；Yang 等，2023；Li 等，2024；Mitchell 等，2023）。 针对代码的变体方法会加入风格相关、任务条件化、微调或基于信号的特征（Shi 等，2024；Ye 等，2024；Skurla 等，2026；Yao 等，2026）。 这些方法通常在固定的一组现有生成器上进行测试，并主要报告准确率，因此它们对新型生成器的稳健性以及对类别坍缩的易感性仍不明确。

sents.en: LLM-output detection uses trained classifiers, zero-shot statistics, or watermarking ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Mitchell et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: LLM输出检测使用训练好的分类器、零样本统计或水印技术（Nguyen 等，2024；Yang 等，2023；Li 等，2024；Mitchell 等，2023）。

sents.en: Code-specific variants add stylistic, task-conditioned, finetuned, or signal-based features ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Skurla et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 针对代码的变体方法会加入风格相关、任务条件化、微调或基于信号的特征（Shi 等，2024；Ye 等，2024；Skurla 等，2026；Yao 等，2026）。

sents.en: These methods are typically tested on a fixed set of existing generators and reported mainly using accuracy, leaving their robustness to newer generators and susceptibility to class collapse unclear.
sents.zh: 这些方法通常在固定的一组现有生成器上进行测试，并主要报告准确率，因此它们对新型生成器的稳健性以及对类别坍缩的易感性仍不明确。

paragraphs.en: General-purpose LLM evaluators avoid detector training ( Pan et al., 2024 ) and may adapt as foundation models improve, though prompt and judge biases remain ( Moon et al., 2026 ) . Unlike Pan et al. (2024) , who evaluate a single prompting strategy, we systematically compare direct and feature-guided prompting across eight judges, seven generators, and three languages, revealing that prompting strategy interacts with judge identity in ways a single-condition evaluation cannot expose.
paragraphs.zh: 通用型 LLM 评估器无需针对检测器进行训练（Pan 等人，2024），并且随着基础模型的性能提升，它们可能会随之调整，尽管提示和评判者中的偏见仍然存在（Moon 等人，2026）。与 Pan 等人不同： （2024）仅评估了单一提示策略，而我们的研究则系统性地比较了直接提示与特征引导提示在八位评判者、七种生成器和三种语言上的表现，发现提示策略与评判者身份之间存在相互作用，这是单一条件评估无法揭示的。

sents.en: General-purpose LLM evaluators avoid detector training ( Pan et al., 2024 ) and may adapt as foundation models improve, though prompt and judge biases remain ( Moon et al., 2026 ) . Unlike Pan et al.
sents.zh: 通用型 LLM 评估器无需针对检测器进行训练（Pan 等人，2024），并且随着基础模型的性能提升，它们可能会随之调整，尽管提示和评判者中的偏见仍然存在（Moon 等人，2026）。与 Pan 等人不同：

sents.en: (2024) , who evaluate a single prompting strategy, we systematically compare direct and feature-guided prompting across eight judges, seven generators, and three languages, revealing that prompting strategy interacts with judge identity in ways a single-condition evaluation cannot expose.
sents.zh: （2024）仅评估了单一提示策略，而我们的研究则系统性地比较了直接提示与特征引导提示在八位评判者、七种生成器和三种语言上的表现，发现提示策略与评判者身份之间存在相互作用，这是单一条件评估无法揭示的。

paragraphs.en: We use the AI-Human-Generated-Program-Code Dataset ( Idrisov and Schlippe, 2024 ) : 18 programming problems (C++, Python, Java), each paired with one human-written solution and one AI-generated solution per generator (StarCoder, ChatGPT, Bing AI Chat, Code Llama, CodeWhisperer, GitHub Copilot, InstructCodeT5+), yielding 18 human and 18 × 7 = 126 18{\times}7{=}126 AI snippets, with the same 18 human solutions used as the baseline for every generator. We evaluate eight LLM judges (Llama 3.1-70B, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Gemini-3-Flash, Ministral-14B, Mistral Large, GPT-3.5-Turbo, GPT-5-mini, Claude Sonnet 5) at temperature 0.1 0.1 , returning a JSON verdict ( "yes" = LLM-generated, "no" = human-written) with justification; human-written code is the positive class. Each query is repeated three times and averaged. We assess four prompting strategies: ❶ Direct zero-shot classification; ❷ Lexical-guided , extracting comments, identifiers, keywords, and libraries first; ❸ Structural-guided , examining control-flow and formatting first; and ❹ Lexico-semantic-guided , combining lexical cues with inferred purpose and semantics first.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 AI-人类生成程序代码数据集（Idrisov 和 Schlippe，2024）：包含 18 个编程问题（C++、Python、Java），每个问题都配有一个由人类编写的解决方案和一个由每个生成器（StarCoder、ChatGPT、Bing AI Chat、Code Llama、CodeWhisperer、GitHub Copilot、InstructCodeT5+）生成的解决方案，从而得到 18 个人类编写的代码片段和 18 × 7 = 126 个 AI 生成的代码片段，其中相同的 18 个人类编写的解决方案被用作每个生成器的基准。 我们在温度设为 0.1 的情况下评估了八个 LLM 评判模型（Llama 3.1-70B、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Gemini-3-Flash、Ministral-14B、Mistral Large、GPT-3.5-Turbo、GPT-5-mini、Claude Sonnet 5），返回一个 JSON 判定（“yes”表示由 LLM 生成，“no”表示由人类编写）以及理由；人类编写的代码是正类。 每个查询重复三次并取平均值。 我们评估了四种提示策略：❶ 直接零样本分类；❷ 词汇引导法，首先提取注释、标识符、关键词和库；❸ 结构引导法，首先检查控制流和格式；以及 ❹ 词汇-语义引导法，首先结合词汇线索与推断出的目的和语义。

sents.zh: 我们使用了 AI-人类生成程序代码数据集（Idrisov 和 Schlippe，2024）：包含 18 个编程问题（C++、Python、Java），每个问题都配有一个由人类编写的解决方案和一个由每个生成器（StarCoder、ChatGPT、Bing AI Chat、Code Llama、CodeWhisperer、GitHub Copilot、InstructCodeT5+）生成的解决方案，从而得到 18 个人类编写的代码片段和 18 × 7 = 126 个 AI 生成的代码片段，其中相同的 18 个人类编写的解决方案被用作每个生成器的基准。

sents.en: We evaluate eight LLM judges (Llama 3.1-70B, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Gemini-3-Flash, Ministral-14B, Mistral Large, GPT-3.5-Turbo, GPT-5-mini, Claude Sonnet 5) at temperature 0.1 0.1 , returning a JSON verdict ( "yes" = LLM-generated, "no" = human-written) with justification; human-written code is the positive class.
sents.zh: 我们在温度设为 0.1 的情况下评估了八个 LLM 评判模型（Llama 3.1-70B、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Gemini-3-Flash、Ministral-14B、Mistral Large、GPT-3.5-Turbo、GPT-5-mini、Claude Sonnet 5），返回一个 JSON 判定（“yes”表示由 LLM 生成，“no”表示由人类编写）以及理由；人类编写的代码是正类。

sents.en: Each query is repeated three times and averaged.
sents.zh: 每个查询重复三次并取平均值。

sents.en: We assess four prompting strategies: ❶ Direct zero-shot classification; ❷ Lexical-guided , extracting comments, identifiers, keywords, and libraries first; ❸ Structural-guided , examining control-flow and formatting first; and ❹ Lexico-semantic-guided , combining lexical cues with inferred purpose and semantics first.
sents.zh: 我们评估了四种提示策略：❶ 直接零样本分类；❷ 词汇引导法，首先提取注释、标识符、关键词和库；❸ 结构引导法，首先检查控制流和格式；以及 ❹ 词汇-语义引导法，首先结合词汇线索与推断出的目的和语义。

Their failure to transfer to this generator set demonstrates that a detector’s useful life is bounded by changes in the generation distribution.

paragraphs.en: Finding 2: LLM judges are a promising but conditional alternative. GPT-5-mini reaches zero-shot F ​ 1 s ​ c ​ o ​ r ​ e F1_{score} of 0.75 0.75 – 0.95 0.95 , far above the dedicated detectors. Feature guidance recovers Llama (up to 0.79 0.79 ) and lifts Claude to 0.94 0.94 , but degrades GPT-5-mini to 0.25 0.25 – 0.40 0.40 under lexico-semantic prompting. Adaptability therefore does not remove the need for judge- and prompt-specific validation.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 2：LLM 评判者是一种前景广阔但带有条件的替代方案。 GPT-5-mini 的零样本 F1 分数（F1_{score}）达到 0.75–0.95，远高于专用检测器。 特征引导恢复了 Llama 的性能（最高达 0.79），并将 Claude 提升至 0.94，但在词汇-语义提示下，却使 GPT-5-mini 的性能降至 0.25–0.40。 因此，适应性并未消除对特定评判者和提示的验证需求。

paragraphs.en: Finding 3: Accuracy can mask biased detectors. The dedicated detectors’ 0.50 accuracy looks like chance performance, but F ​ 1 s ​ c ​ o ​ r ​ e = 0.00 F1_{score}{=}0.00 reveals near-constant “AI” predictions. paragraphs.en: Finding 4: Per-language sensitivity is judge-specific. C++ is Claude’s weakest language under every prompting condition, while GPT-5-mini stays largely language-invariant throughout; Llama and Mistral-Large both flip C++ from their worst language under zero-shot/lexical prompting to their best under structural/stylo-semantic guidance, showing that richer context can reshape which language a judge finds easiest rather than uniformly improving all of them.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 4：不同语言间的敏感度因评判者而异。 在所有提示条件下，C++ 都是 Claude 表现最弱的语言，而 GPT-5-mini 在不同语言间基本保持稳定；Llama 和 Mistral-Large 则都出现了变化：在零样本/词汇提示下，C++ 是它们表现最差的语言，而在结构/风格-语义引导下，C++ 反而成为它们表现最好的语言。这表明更丰富的上下文可以改变评判者认为最容易掌握的语言，而并非均匀地提升所有语言的表现。

sents.en: Finding 4: Per-language sensitivity is judge-specific.
sents.zh: 发现 4：不同语言间的敏感度因评判者而异。

sents.en: C++ is Claude’s weakest language under every prompting condition, while GPT-5-mini stays largely language-invariant throughout; Llama and Mistral-Large both flip C++ from their worst language under zero-shot/lexical prompting to their best under structural/stylo-semantic guidance, showing that richer context can reshape which language a judge finds easiest rather than uniformly improving all of them.
sents.zh: 在所有提示条件下，C++ 都是 Claude 表现最弱的语言，而 GPT-5-mini 在不同语言间基本保持稳定；Llama 和 Mistral-Large 则都出现了变化：在零样本/词汇提示下，C++ 是它们表现最差的语言，而在结构/风格-语义引导下，C++ 反而成为它们表现最好的语言。这表明更丰富的上下文可以改变评判者认为最容易掌握的语言，而并非均匀地提升所有语言的表现。

paragraphs.en: We examined whether general-purpose LLMs can serve as training-free judges of code provenance (RQ1) and how feature-guided prompting affects their reliability (RQ2). Zero-shot judging is highly model-dependent: GPT-5-mini achieves strong discrimination, while several judges collapse toward a single class despite near-chance accuracy. Feature-guided prompting is not uniformly beneficial: it recovers collapsed judges such as Llama but degrades the strongest zero-shot judge, GPT-5-mini. Judgments also vary markedly by generator, suggesting sensitivity to generator-specific style rather than a universal AI/human signal. LLM-based provenance judges should therefore be validated per model and generator, not selected from aggregate scores alone. Future work should examine hybrid human-AI code and provenance-preserving transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了通用大型语言模型（LLM）能否作为无需训练的代码来源判定者（研究问题1），以及特征引导提示如何影响其可靠性（研究问题2）。 零样本判定高度依赖模型：GPT-5-mini 实现了强大的区分能力，而多个判定模型尽管准确率接近随机水平，却倾向于将所有结果归为单一类别。 特征引导提示并非始终有益：它能让 Llama 等已失效的判定模型恢复功能，但反而削弱了最强的零样本判定模型 GPT-5-mini。 判定结果也因生成模型的不同而显著差异，这表明其敏感度更多取决于特定生成模型的风格，而非普适的人工智能/人类信号。 因此，基于大型语言模型的代码来源判定模型应针对具体模型和生成器进行验证，而不能仅依据汇总分数进行选择。 未来研究应探索混合人类与人工智能的代码及来源保留转换方法。

sents.en: We examined whether general-purpose LLMs can serve as training-free judges of code provenance (RQ1) and how feature-guided prompting affects their reliability (RQ2).
sents.zh: 我们研究了通用大型语言模型（LLM）能否作为无需训练的代码来源判定者（研究问题1），以及特征引导提示如何影响其可靠性（研究问题2）。

sents.en: Zero-shot judging is highly model-dependent: GPT-5-mini achieves strong discrimination, while several judges collapse toward a single class despite near-chance accuracy.
sents.zh: 零样本判定高度依赖模型：GPT-5-mini 实现了强大的区分能力，而多个判定模型尽管准确率接近随机水平，却倾向于将所有结果归为单一类别。

sents.en: Feature-guided prompting is not uniformly beneficial: it recovers collapsed judges such as Llama but degrades the strongest zero-shot judge, GPT-5-mini.
sents.zh: 特征引导提示并非始终有益：它能让 Llama 等已失效的判定模型恢复功能，但反而削弱了最强的零样本判定模型 GPT-5-mini。

sents.en: Judgments also vary markedly by generator, suggesting sensitivity to generator-specific style rather than a universal AI/human signal.
sents.zh: 判定结果也因生成模型的不同而显著差异，这表明其敏感度更多取决于特定生成模型的风格，而非普适的人工智能/人类信号。

sents.en: LLM-based provenance judges should therefore be validated per model and generator, not selected from aggregate scores alone.
sents.zh: 因此，基于大型语言模型的代码来源判定模型应针对具体模型和生成器进行验证，而不能仅依据汇总分数进行选择。

sents.en: Future work should examine hybrid human-AI code and provenance-preserving transformations.
sents.zh: 未来研究应探索混合人类与人工智能的代码及来源保留转换方法。
